title: R2 Carbon

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Schuberth R2 Carbon is purpose-built for closed-course competition and apex carving, purpose-built for riders demanding uncompromising high-speed aerodynamic stability and track-certified protection. Built around a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell weighing a featherweight 1303g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~93 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Long Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Schuberth's first pure race helmet with carbon shell and MIPS.

variants.title: Schuberth R2 Carbon Matte Black
variants.description: The Schuberth R2 Carbon is a benchmark Track / Race helmet crafted in Germany 🇩🇪. Built around Direct Fiber Processing (DFP) glass fiber reinforced with carbon matrix tuned in Magdeburg acoustic wind tunnels, it is engineered specifically for Long Oval ergonomics. Designed for aggressive forward tuck and sport-touring postures, delivering maximum high-speed aerodynamic stability and full-coverage chin protection. German aero-acoustic precision delivering unmatched cabin quietness.

product_details.description: Schuberth's first pure race helmet with carbon shell and MIPS.

variants.introduction: Positioned in Schuberth's Track / Race lineup, the R2 Carbon brings German engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for a Long Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
variants.story:
The Schuberth R2 Carbon represents Schuberth's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~93 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Track / Race helmet tailored to a Long Oval head shape, the Schuberth R2 Carbon delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: Schuberth R2 Carbon Matte Black (matte finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: Schuberth R2 Carbon in Schuberth R2 Carbon Matte Black. A precision track weapon delivering uncompromising aerodynamic downforce and premier impact absorption for closed-circuit competition.
variants.fitment_notes: Optimized for Long Oval profiles with snug 3D laser-cut race cheek pads providing emergency quick release (EQRS). Expect an initial 15-20 riding hour break-in for 15-20% foam compression.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Requires precise sizing; Carbon shell offers minimal adjustment post-fitting.

technical_analysis: Features Direct Fiber Processing (DFP) glass fiber reinforced with carbon matrix tuned in Magdeburg acoustic wind tunnels paired with City-position visor ratchet system with integrated drop-down sun visor and pre-installed Sena SC2 Mesh antenna. The interior utilizes Seamless individual customizable lining with Anti-Roll-Off System (AROS) for neck retention stability with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Schuberth R2 Carbon: combining Germany 🇩🇪 craftsmanship with City-position visor ratchet system with integrated drop-down sun visor and pre-installed Sena SC2 Mesh antenna and Seamless individual customizable lining with Anti-Roll-Off System (AROS) for neck retention stability. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Schuberth R2 Carbon: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Schuberth R2 Carbon. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Long Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Schuberth R2 Carbon is a benchmark Lightweight Carbon Streetfighter helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.
